svg.title: Ziyi (Ellen) Zhou — statistician and data engineer, Montréal
svg.desc: Hand-drawn plate: Mount Fuji in winter seen across Lake Ashi in Hakone, with the torii standing in the water and a lit kissaten on the shore, falling snow and a small return-level curve sketched in the sky. On the left: Ziyi (Ellen) Zhou, statistician and data engineer in Montréal, modelling rare, high-impact events.
